_meta.purpose: Illustrative shape of one governed run, from objective to closeout.
_meta.warning: This file does not execute and does not correspond to any real run. Identifiers, agents, timestamps, scores, and content are invented. It is a documentation aid for readers who prefer JSON to prose.
_meta.schema_note: Field names illustrate the concepts described in docs/architecture.md. They are not the production contract and should not be treated as an integration target.

run.objective: Publish a short technical note about the project's approval-gate design across three surfaces.

intake_restatement._note: Design intent: the operator sees and corrects the system's own understanding BEFORE planning. Correcting here is cheap; correcting in the deliverable is not.
intake_restatement.understood_objective: Write one short technical note explaining why irreversible actions block on human approval, and adapt it for three publishing surfaces with different length and tone constraints.
assumptions_surfaced: Audience is technical practitioners, not general readers.
'Short' means under 300 words for the microblog surface.
intake_restatement.operator_correction: Audience is correct. Raise the microblog limit — a thread is acceptable.

plan._note: Version 2 exists because version 1 was rejected. Approval is pinned to a version; approving v1 would not approve v2.

tasks.title: Draft the core technical note
tasks.description: Explain the approval gate: what it blocks, why standing permission is not approval, and where rejection routes.

tasks.title: Adapt for the microblog surface
tasks.description: Restructure the note as a thread under the surface's per-post length constraint.

tasks.title: Adapt for the professional surface
tasks.description: Expand into a single long-form post with a concrete opening example.

plan._dependency_note: Validated as a DAG before approval is offered. A cycle is rejected at validation, so the scheduler can never deadlock on a plan it accepted.
assumptions: Surface length limits are treated as hard constraints, not guidance.
warnings: Publication is an irreversible external action and will stop at an approval gate.

plan_history.comment: Missing the professional surface entirely. Replan.

assignments._note: Matched by declared capability, not by name. Swapping the actor behind a capability changes nothing about the plan.

executions.output_excerpt: Approval gates are the fastest way to keep agents safe...
executions._note: Append-only. This record is retained unchanged after the retry below; a retry appends, it never overwrites.

executions.output_excerpt: A standing permission answers whether an actor may do a kind of thing. An approval gate answers whether this specific thing should happen now...

evaluations._invariant: evaluator_agent_id != executing agent_id — enforced at dispatch and re-validated on write.

remediation.justification: Single, precisely-located criterion failure. Revision is cheaper than reassignment.
remediation._note: Bounded. On exhaustion the run escalates to a human rather than continuing to retry.

approvals._note: The acting agent held a valid, scoped, unexpired grant for this capability and was STILL blocked. Permission is not approval.

_audit_note: Append-only, with redacted before/after values omitted here for readability. Enforced at the application layer AND independently at the storage layer.
_absent_by_design: real platform API request or response bodies
real accounts, people, organizations, or content
